invariants.rationale: The method always constructs and returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata instance as 'result', so it should never be null.
Method contracts in Hudi typically expect non-null input; this is also needed to process inputRecords.
WriteStatuses list is assigned and passed to result in all executing paths.
Result.getWriteStatuses() is expected to return a List<WriteStatus>.
The size of a List is always non-negative, and result.getWriteStatuses() is a List.
